observations.observation: An identical German language fact was stored as a second active-version record instead of reusing the existing value, increasing records from m001 to m002.
A third identical German language fact was stored as m003, leaving three records for the same value and key before retrieval.

hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values during repeated confirmations, reducing stored records without changing retrieval answers or write admission.
predicted_effect: The duplicate-confirmation scenario should retain the German answer while avoiding redundant version records; complete-scenario success should remain at least as high and storage should decrease. No hard-constraint impact is expected.
